review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Project Controls Cost Analyst will be responsible for providing analytics support for a portion of the GPC Distribution Capital Portfolio with the Project Control Cost Supervisor oversight. The analyst will be part of a team responsible for project level cost performance analysis needed to support the Distribution organization, Project Controls team, and GPC Accounting, Finance, and Treasurer organization (AFT). This team will also be responsible for providing project cost review, capital budget analysis and funding solution proposals for specific projects and blanket budgets. Key Responsibilities Analyze cost and schedule data to identify risks, variances, and potential issues; develop corrective actions and present recommendations to management. Perform detailed analysis of capital spend and project closures for a business unit within the GPC Distribution organization Support portfolio management of capital programs, including forecasting, change management, risk assessment, and contingency planning Monitor business unit performance against established KPIs within the GPC Distribution Capital Program. Develop and review project budgets using historical data, actual performance, revenue projections, and expense trends to ensure effective financial control Track project performance against baseline budgets and key milestones, identifying variances, and recommending mitigation strategies Conduct Estimate at Completion (EAC) analyses across all cost elements, incorporating commitments, expenditures, change orders, and emerging trends Extract, analyze, and generate standard and ad hoc reports from financial and project accounting systems to support cost tracking and decision-making Collaborate with project controls teams to support change impact analysis and ensure any approved changes are incorporated into cost Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Accounting, Finance, or related field, or relevant experience Experience 2+ years of experience in cost analysis, project controls, estimating, financial analysis, or construction/project accounting Familiarity with project lifecycle, cost management processes, and budget controls Experience with cost management and reporting tools (e.g., Oracle, Excel, Power BI, or similar platforms) Understanding of cost large-scale organizational change efforts Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity and apply problem-solving skills Working experience providing data and ensuring data integrity to support accurate review_candidates.title: Project Associate - Gender and Digital Empowerment
review_candidates.description: IT for Change (ITfC) is a not-for-profit organization whose mission is to end digital inequality and advance just, equitable, and people-led digital futures. ITfC works through three strategic program areas: Gender and Digital Empowerment, Public EdTech, and Just Digital Governance. The Gender and Digital Empowerment program works with adolescent girls across rural, semi-urban, and urban Karnataka, inside schools and within communities. We are currently expanding our program and are looking for a Project Associate to support program delivery, documentation, and impact reporting for our in-school interventions. Position Title Project Associate Location Bengaluru, Karnataka with in-office presence Reporting To Head - Gender and Digital Empowerment Role This is a field-facing, ownership-driven role at the heart of the adolescent empowerment program. The Project Associate will facilitate curriculum delivery in schools, help build and apply the program's MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) systems, support funder reporting, and create digital content that documents and communicates program impact. The role bridges direct program delivery with the data, documentation, and relationship-building that sustain and grow the initiative.  Key Responsibilities 01: Program Delivery & Facilitation Facilitate the adolescent empowerment curriculum and digital skilling for adolescent girls and boys across Bengaluru schools. Manage field implementation across schools, colleges, and community settings, including day-to-day coordination.  02: Monitoring, Evaluation & Impact Documentation Track program indicators (MEL) such as shifts in awareness, attitudes, and practices,  and capture impact. Document project work and contribute to program strategy and ideation. 03: Digital content creation & Dissemination Develop digital resources including audio/video for program curriculum, toolkits and social media. Support program outreach with funders and peer organizations. 04: Donor & Funder Reporting Own donor and funder reporting for one or more institutional partners, including narrative and data inputs. Track reporting timelines and compliance requirements in coordination with the program lead. 05: Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement Build and sustain relationships with schools, education departments, and partner civil society organizations. Support staff training and onboarding, including field protocols and data norms. Core Competencies Gender and adolescent empowerment expertise: Solid grasp of gender dynamics and adolescence, with a strong commitment to feminist values and an inclusive workplace. Program implementation and field facilitation: Hands-on experience delivering curriculum and running activities directly with adolescents in school and/or community settings. Monitoring and evaluation: Ability to design and apply MEL tools, and to maintain data quality and consistency. Communication and content creation: Comfort with creating digital content, including audio and video, for social media and outreach, and translating program work into donor-facing narratives. Language proficiency: Solid hold on Kannada language (spoken, written and typing) along with English.  Ownership and self-direction: Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and own program components end-to-end, delivering reliably. Who We Are Looking For Postgraduate degree in Social Work, Gender Studies, Development Studies, Sociology, or a related field. 3–4 years' experience working on-ground with adolescent girls and young women. Proficient in Kannada and English, spoken and written; Kannada typing is mandatory.  Fluent with applications and tech tools, and open to picking up new tech skills. What We Offer Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to social change Collaborative and mission-driven work environment Scope for professional growth and leadership Engagement with diverse partners and stakeholders A flexible and hybrid work environment, with three in-person office days a week A competitive compensation package including health benefits, with salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Application Process For more details about the job and to apply, fill this form: https://bit.ly/gdeassociate Last date to apply: 25th September 2026 Know more about the Gender and Digital Empowerment Program here: https://bit.ly/gdeprogram

review_candidates.title: Project Administrator
review_candidates.description: About Us Abergeldie is a majority locally owned contractor with 30 years’ industry experience in Australia and New Zealand. We design and deliver projects in the Water, Bridges, Transport, Underground, Energy and Remediation industry sectors. Projects include dams, bridges, tunnels, water and wastewater treatment process facilities, rail infrastructure, mining infrastructure, electrical substations, marine works and pipeline rehabilitation: the complex infrastructure needed to build better communities. About The Opportunity We’re looking for a Project Administrator to join our team in Sydney. This is a key support role where you’ll work closely with Project Managers, Engineers and commercial teams to help deliver complex infrastructure projects across a range of sectors. As a Project Administrator, you'll play an important part in keeping projects running smoothly by supporting project controls, procurement, reporting, document management and day-to-day administration. You'll join a collaborative team environment and have the opportunity to contribute to diverse and challenging projects while building your career with a leading infrastructure contractor. This is a full-time permanent position, with a salary range of $84,000 - $94,000 base + super (dependent on experience). What You’ll Bring To The Team Previous experience in a Project Administrator, Site Administrator or similar role within the construction, engineering or infrastructure sectors. Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Experience supporting project teams with procurement, reporting, document control and general project administration. High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate work. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook. Experience with project management, ERP or document control systems will be highly regarded. A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Why You Should Work With Us Our people are what make Abergeldie successful, and we make sure that this is the kind of place where great people enjoy working for the long term. We have a range of employee benefits, including the Abergeldie Bonus Scheme, where all eligible employees share in the benefits of the projects they have helped to deliver. When we deliver winning projects, we celebrate success together. Interested? If this sounds like you, apply now! #bestpeople #bestdelivery #bestplanning #SYD
